backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing PDF share backend with chunked upload flow (startUpload, uploadChunk, finalizeUpload), user profile management, ban/kick functionality, and access-control authorization via mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three implemented features (FeedPage creation, Feed nav link, /feed route registration) to their source files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference for the project's frontend structure.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, card, primary, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA with a root div and a module script entry point at /src/main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router setup defining all application routes (/, /gallery redirect, /feed, /upload, /dashboard, /view/:shareId) wrapped in a shared Header/Footer layout.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright year and a caffeine.ai attribution link with UTM parameters and a heart icon.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky navigation header with logo, active-route-highlighted links for Gallery, Feed (Rss icon), Upload, and Dashboard, plus Internet Identity login/logout button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP actor, initializing access control with an admin token when authenticated and invalidating dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, wrapping DFINITY's AuthClient to expose login, logout, and identity state with status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines TanStack Query hooks for all backend interactions including listing, uploading (chunked), deleting, renaming PDFs, and managing banned users.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Inter and Space Grotesk fonts, defining a dark navy/amber CSS variable theme, and declaring reusable Tailwind component classes like card-glass and btn-amber.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard page displaying the authenticated user's uploaded PDFs in a list with inline title editing, copy-link, delete, and admin controls for banning/kicking users.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Community feed page that displays all platform-wide PDF uploads sorted newest-first in a responsive card grid with navigation to individual PDF views.
frontend/src/pages/GalleryPage.tsx: Gallery page that renders all publicly shared PDFs in a responsive card grid, with loading skeletons, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with a hero section, feature highlights ('How it works'), and a stats/CTA section, linking to the upload and dashboard pages.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPage.tsx: PDF upload page that handles chunked file uploads to the backend canister, tracks upload progress, manages Internet Identity authentication state, and displays a shareable link on completion.
frontend/src/pages/ViewerPage.tsx: PDF viewer page that fetches PDF metadata and binary content (via XHR with progress tracking) by shareId, renders the PDF in an iframe, and supports next-PDF navigation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL query parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts, oklch-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins enabled.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state including version, summary, architectural notes, known issues, and a list of existing features with their IDs, titles, requirement references, and version numbers for a PDF-sharing website built on the Internet Computer.
